description: Detector alarms and their quality on checked validation days. Faults are SYNTHETIC (validation weeks); incidents use the provisional M2 grouping.

panels.description: Cell-intervals in telemetry_raw (filled by `make sink`) and alarms the detector raised. Topology and latency / load KPIs are synthetic/modeled.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(interval_start, '1h'), count(*) AS telemetry_rows
FROM telemetry_raw
WHERE replay_run_id = '$run' AND $__timeFilter(interval_start)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(interval_start, '1h'), count(*) AS alarms
FROM alarms
WHERE replay_run_id = '$run' AND $__timeFilter(interval_start)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Alarms vs telemetry per hour (replay run $run)

panels.description: Faults are SYNTHETIC (validation weeks); incidents use the provisional M2 grouping.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, false_incidents
FROM detection_reports_latest WHERE $__timeFilter(day::timestamptz) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: False incidents per checked day (SYNTHETIC faults)

panels.description: Faults are SYNTHETIC (validation weeks); incidents use the provisional M2 grouping.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, delay_median, delay_low, delay_high
FROM detection_reports_latest WHERE $__timeFilter(day::timestamptz) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Detection delay, Kaplan-Meier median (intervals; SYNTHETIC faults)

panels.description: Faults are SYNTHETIC (validation weeks); incidents use the provisional M2 grouping. parity: streamed alarms == offline scoring.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day, detector_version, faults, unobservable, detected,
  round(detected::numeric / nullif(faults - unobservable, 0), 3) AS detection_rate,
  delay_median, delay_low, delay_high, incidents, false_incidents, parity,
  replay_run_id
FROM detection_reports_latest WHERE $__timeFilter(day::timestamptz) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Checked days (make detect-check; SYNTHETIC faults)
